criteria.title: Explicit operator relays remain highest priority
criteria.assertion: When --relay is provided, the CLI uses only those final relays and does not invoke bootstrap discovery, even if environment or discovery inputs are present.

criteria.title: Environment final relays remain second priority
criteria.assertion: When --relay is absent and BAHIA_NOSTR_RELAYS is set, the CLI uses those final relays and does not invoke bootstrap discovery.

criteria.title: Bootstrap discovery requires seed relays and trusted service pubkeys
criteria.assertion: Trusted operator bootstrap discovery runs only when no final relay config exists and both bootstrap relays plus trusted service pubkeys are configured; missing final/discovery inputs fail deterministically.

criteria.title: Discovery prefers ContextVM relays then browser relays
criteria.assertion: The shared operator discovery resolver subscribes to trusted NIP-51 kind 30002 relay sets scoped to d=bahia-contextvm-v1 and d=bahia-browser-v1, validates trusted signed events, prefers usable ContextVM relay sets, and falls back to usable browser relay sets.

criteria.title: Missing trust or trusted relay events fail deterministically
criteria.assertion: Missing trusted pubkeys, untrusted relay-set authors, invalid signatures, wrong d tags, or no trusted events before EOSE produce explicit errors and no discovered relays.
